title: Puncturer
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/Puncturer.md
text: Punctures data according to puncture vector, 5 inputs, 3 outputs; {Operation mode} sets the mode of operation, {Encoder rate} sets the rate of encoder, {Puncture vector source} sets the source of puncture vector and {Puncture vector} sets the location of data to be punctured. Values come from the instance.
